## Why A typical PR takes about 13 minutes because smoke, Playwright, Maestro, and the GCP preview each run their slow steps one after another. ## What changed - Smoke compiles in one job and exports admin-spa, demo, and example-frontend in three others, then runs the package smokes. - Playwright prepare compiles and exports together. The long `app` shard is now `app-todos`, `app-shell`, and `app-ai`. - Maestro installs Java and compiles while the web export runs. - A GCP preview builds the example-backend image once and deploys the backend and tasks services together. - `api-ci` runs two shards. Each starts its own memory Mongo. ## Verification | Status | Scope | Evidence / action | | --- | --- | --- | | ✅ Tested | Shard wiring, source resolver, parallel runner | `bun test` on the CI scripts: 26 pass | | ⚠️ Not tested | Real CircleCI duration | This PR's pipeline is the measurement. If branch protection still requires `e2e-app`, replace it with `e2e-app-todos`, `e2e-app-shell`, and `e2e-app-ai`. |
  
--- > [!NOTE] > **Medium Risk** > Touches production Docker image build and GCP preview deploy orchestration; incorrect parallelism could break CI or previews, but application runtime/auth logic is largely unchanged. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit ef8588996291ff81a03d1847d18c5dfa5881376a. title: Get PR CI wall time under 7 minutes

## Why Role permissions were action names only (`read`, `update`, `signoff`). Admins could not tell what a grant does, and the colored action badges could not be turned off. ## What changed - Every framework permission has an optional description. Apps pass `createAccess({ statementDescriptions })`; those labels override the framework ones, and a blank string is ignored. - `GET /rbac/statements` returns the merged map as `data.statementDescriptions`. - `AdminRolesList` and `AppRolesList` show the label beside the action badge and under the editor checkbox. - `showActionBadges={false}` hides the badges. Each permission then stacks on its own line: the description, or the action name when there is none. ## Verification | Status | Scope | Evidence / action | | --- | --- | --- | | ✅ Tested | Statement merge, statements route, both roles screens | `bun test` on `api/src/rbac/statements.test.ts`, `api/src/rbac/routes.test.ts`, `admin-frontend` roles tests, `example-frontend/components/AppRolesList.test.tsx`, `example-backend/src/access.test.ts` | | ✅ Tested | Example roles screen at `/admin/roles` | Signed in as superadmin. Badges plus descriptions, the add-role editor, and badges hidden with one label per line. The demo `showActionBadges={false}` prop was reverted. | [Roles screen with action badges and descriptions](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-72022cfd-2107-4ca0-a4c2-b4cb663454db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Froles-descriptions-badges.png) [Add role editor with a description under signoff](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-72022cfd-2107-4ca0-a4c2-b4cb663454db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Froles-editor-description.png) [Roles screen with badges hidden and one description per line](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-72022cfd-2107-4ca0-a4c2-b4cb663454db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Froles-badges-hidden.png) [roles-permission-descriptions.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-72022cfd-2107-4ca0-a4c2-b4cb663454db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Froles-permission-descriptions.mp4) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
  
--- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Adds optional metadata and UI for RBAC statements without changing authorization checks or role persistence; risk is mainly display/API response shape for consumers of `/rbac/statements`. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit b828ff82dc9b6337a7aca0fef8b24758a0e793bb. body:
## Why

Two `@terreno/test` bugs made app test suites fail. The first app file to build in `beforeAll` got no `TOKEN_SECRET`, so anonymous requests returned 500 `Unknown authentication strategy "jwt"`. And under Bun on macOS, roughly one full run in seven failed a random test when another local app answered `supertest(app)`'s request.

## What changed

- `registerBackendPreload` / `registerSimpleMongoPreload` apply `testEnv` when registered, not only in `beforeEach`.
- New `testRequest(app)`, a drop-in for `supertest(app)`. It binds 127.0.0.1, because Bun's `listen(0)` binds only `*:<port>` on IPv6 while supertest sends to `127.0.0.1:<port>`. It also closes its server after each request; under Bun supertest never did, because Bun leaves `_handle` unset.
- `authAsUser` and `authWithToken` agents use the same server. `createLoopbackServer(app)` is exported.
- Docs in `docs/reference/test.md` and `test/README.md`, plus a changelog fragment.

Other packages' `supertest(app)` calls (~880) aren't migrated here; that's a follow-up.

## Verification

| Status | Scope | Evidence / action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ Tested | Loopback bind, server close, agent server | `test/src/http/testRequest.test.ts`; all 4 tests fail against plain `createServer` |
| ✅ Tested | Env before `beforeAll` | `registerBackendPreload.env.test.ts` runs a child `bun test` with only the fixture preload; it fails without the fix |
| ✅ Tested | Both bugs in a real app | sungold: 0 failures in 30 full runs (about 1 in 7 before); its CI is green |
| ✅ Tested | `bun run prepush` | 18/20 steps pass. The other 2 fail locally only: `declare -A` on macOS bash 3.2, and the Expo/`runBin` tests, which also fail on master |
| ⚠️ Not tested | Linux CI | Rely on CircleCI for the `test` package jobs |

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes preload env timing (affects every backend test using these registrars) and alters how auth HTTP helpers bind and tear down servers under Bun; bounded to `@terreno/test` with new tests.
> 
> **Overview**
> Fixes two Bun test-suite failure modes in **`@terreno/test`**.
> 
> **Preload / test env:** `registerBackendPreload` (and thus `registerSimpleMongoPreload`) now calls `setTerrenoTestEnv` **at registration time**, not only in `beforeEach`. Apps built in a file's `beforeAll` now see `TOKEN_SECRET` and related vars before JWT strategy registration runs.
> 
> **HTTP helpers:** Adds **`testRequest(app)`** and **`createLoopbackServer`**, a `supertest` wrapper that listens on **`127.0.0.1`** and forces server teardown under Bun by stubbing `_handle`. **`authAsUser`** and **`authWithToken`** use the same loopback server. Docs, changelog, package exports, and unit/integration tests cover bind address, post-request close, and env-before-`beforeAll` behavior.
> 
> Bulk migration of existing `supertest(app)` call sites is intentionally out of scope.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit feeccc701b5b962a098a27cab02a915d88870293. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>

title: Bind supertest servers to 127.0.0.1 and apply test env before beforeAll
